name: seis-release-cadence
description: Analyze local release heading intervals without GitHub or publishing access.

interface.shortDescription: Measure local release intervals from changelog evidence.
interface.longDescription: Extracts dated or versioned release headings from bounded local changelogs and reports cadence gaps. It does not query GitHub, publish releases or infer delivery performance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze release cadence from this local repository's changelog evidence.
